quotes.text: Bug 1897920 corrected Thunderbird scripting.compose.registerScripts and scripting.messageDisplay.registerScripts after Bug 1896870 and upstream behavior showed the MDN return-value description was wrong. Registration now resolves without a scripts array. The schema callbacks have no parameters, and browser tests verify registered details through getRegisteredScripts instead. When changing an extension API, update implementation, schema, and tests together, and confirm the upstream contract rather than relying on a single documentation page.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
